evidence.source: Taiwan Ministry of Education, Dictionary of Chinese Character Variants
evidence.text: The entry distinguishes the received Great Xu wording 道也。从足，从各 from Duan Yucai’s interpretation 道也。从足，各聲, and gives the Mandarin reading lù. Thus the explicit phonetic analysis is Duan’s commentary, not the wording of the received entry.
evidence.title: [A04015] 路 - 教育部《異體字字典》

evidence.field: Shuowen commentary; graphic forms; cited meanings
evidence.text: The page reproduces the Shuowen definition 道也 and Duan’s note 从足。各聲. Its chart lists a mid-Western Zhou bronze form attributed to 史懋壺, Chu manuscript examples, a Shuowen seal form, and Qin-slip forms. This is a secondary chart, not a primary inscription publication or a complete account of graphic change. Its separate glosses include road/path, journey or route, and extended or homophonous uses; their displayed order does not establish semantic chronology.
evidence.title: 路 lù - 汉典

evidence.text: The database describes coverage of oracle-bone, bronze, Warring States, seal, and regular-script forms. Its notice says glyph images and glyph-attribute information obtained through its query interface are released under CC0 1.0. The character-specific page opened without readable record content in this run, so this does not independently verify the 路 bronze identification.
evidence.title: 小學堂新手入門

evidence.text: The official character entry identifies 路 as U+8DEF and gives Mandarin lù. This independently supports the current reading; it is not evidence for an ancient sound relationship.
evidence.title: 字形資訊 - [路] 1-667B - 全字庫 CNS11643

evidence.text: Unicode describes Unihan readings as pronunciation data that varies over time, place, and language. The inspected standard documents the dataset but does not provide the exact kMandarin value for 路 or 各 in the inspected lines.
evidence.title: UAX #38: Unicode Han Database (Unihan)

evidence.source: University of Michigan-hosted Baxter–Sagart reconstruction table
evidence.field: Baxter–Sagart 路 and 各 comparison
evidence.text: The official table PDF was attempted but returned an internal error. The dossier’s harness-provided local rows report 各 MC kak, OC *kˤak and 路 MC luH, OC *Cə.rˤak-s. These are distinct readings in one reconstruction system, but the local data is not external page verification and the comparison alone does not demonstrate the phonetic role.
evidence.title: Baxter-Sagart Old Chinese reconstruction, version 1.1 (20 September 2014)

evidence.source: Unicode Consortium, Unihan Database Search Page
evidence.text: The inspected official search page says Unihan can be queried by properties including Mandarin. The interface page itself did not return character-specific results for 路 or 各; it cannot substantiate their exact readings here.
evidence.title: Unihan Database Search Page

search_audit.query: 路 說文 解字 甲骨文 金文 字形 路 足 各; Baxter Sagart 2014 路 各 kak luH Middle Chinese table PDF; 路 詩經 周禮 最早 用例 路 道也 古漢語
search_audit.outcome: Fresh search performed and relevant pages inspected. Han Dian and the Taiwan MOE entry opened; Xiaoxuetang’s guide opened but its 路-specific record did not expose readable content. Baxter–Sagart PDF, CUHK result, and both character-specific Unicode Unihan pages failed to open. The search did not establish a primary inscription image or secure first textual occurrence.

search_audit.query: Baxter Sagart 路 各 kak luH Middle Chinese table PDF; 路 U+8DEF Unicode Unihan kMandarin official; 各 U+5404 Unicode Unihan kMandarin official; 史懋壺 集成9714 路 銘文 拓片 路字
search_audit.outcome: Search surfaced official CNS11643 reading data, official Unihan documentation, and secondary Baxter–Sagart mirrors. CNS11643 and UAX #38 were opened and inspected. No primary inscription publication or successful official exact Unihan reading record was obtained; the secondary mirror was not used as a substitute for the failed primary table.

gaps: Exact current Unihan kMandarin records for 路 and 各 remained inaccessible. Current 路 lù is supported by the official Taiwan CNS11643 page; the harness-provided local row gives 各 gè, but that local row is not external evidence and no verified official character-specific click-through page was obtained.

The only exact Baxter–Sagart pair available in this packet is from harness-provided local rows: 各 MC kak / OC *kˤak and 路 MC luH / OC *Cə.rˤak-s. The official PDF failed to open, so an externally verified paired transcription is unavailable; these forms do not amount to an identical reconstruction.

Modern Mandarin comparison remains 各 gè and 路 lù according to provided local readings and dossier data, but only 路 was independently verified from an opened official character-specific source in this run.

The received Shuowen account pairs 足 and 各 without explicitly assigning a sound role; Duan Yucai explicitly reads 各 as phonetic. 足’s semantic contribution is plausible in this conventional analysis, but the precise formation-era motivation is not directly attested in the inspected evidence.

A secondary chart names a mid-Western Zhou bronze 路 attributed to 史懋壺, but no artifact image, primary paleographic publication, or inscription context was inspected. No oracle-bone form was found in the inspected character-specific references; this is a coverage gap, not proof of absence.

No dated first use or reliable chronological sequence for journey/distance and figurative extensions was established. Dictionary citations illustrate uses but cannot alone determine when each sense arose.

The dossier’s proposals involving 格, Proto-Austroasiatic road words, and possible whole-graph borrowing remain unverified; no source-word evidence or independent sound chronology was obtained. No evidence supported graphic corruption or a particular mistaken reinterpretation.

No tracked online extract is recommended: exact bulk-reuse permission was not established for the dictionary material, and the Xiaoxuetang CC0 notice applies to its query-interface glyph images and glyph attributes, not to unrelated sites or corpora.
